ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level ratio estimated at 15:85 white-to-black; high-intensity pixels are restricted to the trailing edges and distal tips against a dominant low-intensity dark grey/black ground.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white mottling and contiguous spots localized along the entire trailing edge boundary, with dense clusters at the lateral lobe tips; central fluke regions exhibit uniform low-intensity dark pigmentation.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, stochastic serrations identified along the continuous boundary of both lobes; right lobe tip shows a large, irregular jagged protrusion approximately 25 pixels in depth from the mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curve trajectory transitioning from a vertical central orientation to a horizontal lateral extension.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular white pixel clusters (rosettes) detected at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme distal tip of the right lobe exhibits irregular, jagged morphology with possible necrotic tissue or persistent biological debris trailing into the water column.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive presence of high-intensity transient water droplet pixels occluding portions of the mid-fluke surface.
